title: Other instruments as a kid: piano, banjo, ukulele
summary: He fooled around on piano, was given a banjo and learned it before cornet, and played ukulele.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: Did you ever play any other instruments when you were a kid even before you took up cornet, like guitar, fool around with them?

No, the only thing I did fool around with as a kid was piano. I fooled around with it. To be honest I never did turn out to really be a pianist. I know the Kord Foundation, I'm not much on the article. Your mother had a piano in there at home I guess. I just sort of picked it up that way a little around there because that was about the first thing. But incidentally though, I was given a banjo by a guy. The guy just gave a banjo, but I didn't even know the guy. I mean it was a big surprise. I did start on that banjo before I started on the cornet. What made me learn the banjo was because a friend of mine, Sidney Cates, he was taking it up at the time. I was watching him and everything else about the lessons and everything. And I just caught on to it and I like it pretty well and I did pretty well on it. Then that's where my heart came along. Although I didn't, but I mean I didn't have too much interest in it, no more than fool around. Then fool around ukulele, I used to play ukulele a lot around there.
